meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度多名AI助手分工协作,完成穷尽式调研并输出综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要就复杂议题做系统深入的研究并得到带引用的结论
copy.tagline_en: Direct a team of AI agents to run exhaustive research and deliver a synthesis report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need systematic deep research on complex topics with cited conclusions

howto.what: 接到研究请求后先问交付格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),再建最多 8 人协作团队分头调查并互相质疑;线索追到枯竭,争议论断用代码验证或走 claim-graph 门禁,最后输出带引用报告,经视觉质检和写作校对。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求研究时触发:提到「ulw-research」等关键词、要求深度研究,或提出 ultradebate/hyperdebate 研究;普通提问与调试不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调研一下 RAG 的最新进展。
say.note: 会先确认交付格式,再组队展开调查。

say.text: 对「XX 框架的稳定性」做一次 hyperdebate 研究。
say.note: 会组建互相质疑的团队交叉审查结论。

say.text: ulw-research 深挖:这个报错在什么条件下出现?
say.note: 会按线索穷尽相关来源并写进报告。

howto.what_en: It asks for the deliverable format (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size team (up to 8: one per axis plus skeptics), expands every lead until dry, proves contested claims via code, and delivers a cited synthesis after visual QA and writing proofread.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit research requests: 'ulw-research' wording, ultradebate/hyperdebate requests, or any research/deep-research ask, in any language. Normal questions, debugging, or implementation gathering never trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on the latest RAG advances.
say_en.note: It asks for the output format, then builds a team.

say_en.text: Do a hyperdebate research pass on framework X's stability.
say_en.note: A skeptical team cross-checks the findings.

say_en.text: ulw-research: dig into when this error appears.
say_en.note: It exhausts every lead and records findings.
